body: green crop residue marks the short rope; a scraped warning stripe marks the water bottle. both are tied with the same cord.
title: Short rope carrying two traces
gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.

body: The notebook rests across the bucket. Its page labels two strips “control — standing” and “trial spray — curled by noon.” The next line reads “mix still active after valve shut.”
title: The trial strip curled after spraying
gloss: A trial mixture remained active after application and damaged the test strip.
rival_reading: A farm worker could record ordinary crop damage and a poorly shut valve; the notes do not establish an experimental program.
